title: Replication package for Explainability Requirements for Fitness Routine Recommendations: A Field Case Study in Ecuador
description: Anonymized replication package for a requirements-engineering field case study on explainability requirements for a proposed fitness-routine recommendation component in FabroGym. Includes 16 anonymized session transcripts, questionnaire data, terminal requirements, traceability, thematic coding, member-checking decisions, processed results, manuscript-supporting material and reproducible analysis scripts. Identifiable audiovisual evidence and original consent material are excluded. The package also preserves 59 coded fragments from the ten initial interviews (ENTR-01..10), separated from the six walkthroughs used for the terminal explainability analysis.
